description: Four captured searches and selected opens do not reproduce LexisNexis or systematically screen all weeks, provinces and sectors; no zero-event conclusion is supported.
Union Region Opole reports >600 but attributes the story to Tysol; ESKA confirms the picket/demands without a count. Count remains one union-network origin.
TVN24 exact target returned HTTP 403; do not retry. Date, actual occurrence, simultaneous turnout and continuity remain unresolved.
Gov.pl exact PDF request timed out at tool level without HTTP status; no publisher denial was observed, but PDF body remains unread.
No systematic province/week census. Nov 27 article mentions planned returns but does not verify future actions or campaign onset/continuation.
